strategic.statement: Deliver over-by-over win probability updates with <30s latency from ball completion to API response
Model every player-coach-venue dimension that correlates with match outcomes
Expose LLM-generated reasoning narratives alongside probability scores for fantasy UX integration
Maintain >72% prediction accuracy across a full IPL season on held-out test matches
Build a modular, cloud-agnostic architecture ready to scale to BBL, SA20, ILT20

non_goals_v1: Player auction valuation or team composition advisor

data_sources.name: CricSheet
data_sources.description: Ball-by-ball historical data for all IPL seasons
data_sources.notes: Foundation for all model training. Download all IPL match YAMLs and parse to tabular.

data_sources.name: Cricbuzz API
data_sources.description: Live match data, ball-by-ball commentary stream, scorecards
data_sources.notes: Primary live data feed. Requires paid API key. Has rate limits — implement exponential backoff.

data_sources.name: ESPNcricinfo API
data_sources.description: Player profiles, career statistics, match summaries
data_sources.notes: Use for player biographical features and career aggregates. Supplement with CricSheet.

data_sources.name: Official IPL Feed
data_sources.description: Squad announcements, playing XI, toss results, injury updates
data_sources.notes: Most reliable source for playing XI and toss. Pursue official BCCI/IPL data partnership.

data_sources.name: Custom Scraper
data_sources.description: Coach win records, auction prices, venue condition reports, team news
data_sources.notes: Use Scrapy or Playwright. Target: HowStat, CricketArchive, franchise press releases. Respect robots.txt.

feature_store.anti_pattern: NO future data leakage — all features must be available at prediction time

risks.risk: Live data API downtime (Cricbuzz / IPL feed)
risks.mitigation: Multi-source fallback: if primary fails, secondary activates within 10s
30s timeout; if exceeded, serve ML output only with confidence_tag=SYSTEM_FALLBACK

risks.risk: Model drift mid-season (new players, foreign conditions)
risks.mitigation: Online fine-tuning pipeline + inference-time feature override
Point-in-time feature store with strict cutoff enforcement + leakage unit tests

risks.risk: Fantasy platform webhook overload during finals
risks.mitigation: Queue-backed delivery with Redis buffer; horizontal scaling on Cloud Run

risks.risk: IPL data licensing or scraping legal risk
risks.mitigation: Prioritise official IPL feed; restrict scraping to publicly available aggregators

open_questions.question: Can we source real-time pitch condition data from broadcast APIs, or rely solely on historical venue profiles?
Will the official IPL feed provide injury/availability updates reliably enough as a hard feature, or only as a soft signal?
At scale (74 matches × 40 overs × 2 LLM calls/over), Anthropic API costs need profiling — consider Haiku for low-stakes overs.
open_questions.resolution: RESOLVED: ~$16.78/season at 74 matches with 30% low-stakes skip rate. Cost is acceptable. See artifacts/llm_cost_estimate.json.

open_questions.question: Will fantasy platform partner share user team composition data for personalised prediction context in v2.0?
Cloud provider final selection: cost modelling for GCP vs AWS vs hybrid needed before Phase 0 infra setup.
